text: Change to standard dig mode.
translation: 切换至一般挖掘模式。

text: Change to standard chop mode.
translation: 切换至一般伐木模式。

text: Set plant gathering orders.  Some plants require fruit or other growths to be present.
translation: 指定采集植物。有些植物必须长有果实或其他可采集部位。

text: Change to standard gather mode.
translation: 切换至一般采集模式。

text: Change to standard orders mode.
translation: 切换至一般指令模式。

text: Set the exact weight in steps of a traffic type.
translation: 设定此通行类型在寻路时的步数权重。

text: Remove the stockpile being painted permanently.  Also removes existing zones!
translation: 永久移除正在绘制的储物堆，也会移除现有区域！

text: Repaint this stockpile.
translation: 重新绘制此储物堆。

text: Erase a portion of this stockpile.
translation: 擦除此储物堆的一部分。

text: Remove this stockpile permanently.
translation: 永久移除此储物堆。

text: Toggle whether the stockpile can take items from anywhere or only from specific workshops and stockpiles.
translation: 切换储物堆可从任何地方收取物品，或只从指定工坊与储物堆收取。

text: Start painting a new zone.  Once the tiles are chosen, you'll be able to set the details.
translation: 开始绘制新区域。选好地格后即可设定详细资料。

text: Go to the previous zone overlapping the tile you clicked.
translation: 切换至与所选地格重叠的上一个区域。

text: Go to the next zone overlapping the tile you clicked.
translation: 切换至与所选地格重叠的下一个区域。

text: Repaint this zone.
translation: 重新绘制此区域。

text: Suspend activities in this zone.  Does not remove the zone.
translation: 暂停此区域内的活动，区域仍会保留。

text: Remove this zone permanently.
translation: 永久移除此区域。

text: Gather fruit in trees in and just above this zone.  Requires a stepladder.
translation: 采集此区域内及其正上方树木的果实，需要梯凳。

text: Gather fruit and vegetables from shrubs in this zone.
translation: 采集此区域灌木上的果实与蔬菜。

text: Gather fallen fruit in this zone.
translation: 采集此区域内掉落的果实。

text: Select animals to be placed in this pasture zone.  They will stay after being led here.
translation: 选择要安置在此牧场的动物。牠们被牵来后便会留在此处。

text: Designate this zone as the top of a pit.  Citizens will not fill the pit below with water.
translation: 将此区域指定为坑口。居民不会向下方坑洞注水。

text: Designate this zone as the top of a pond.  Citizens will bring buckets of water if the pond below isn't filled.
translation: 将此区域指定为池塘上方的注水口。下方池塘未满时，居民会提水桶前来注水。

text: Select animals to be dropped into the pit or pond below this zone.  Animals will not feel obligated to stay if they can find a way out.
translation: 选择要投入此区域下方坑洞或池塘的动物。若能找到出口，牠们可能自行离开。

text: Assign a new or existing location to this zone.  Locations are groups of zones and rooms with a larger purpose, like a tavern, a temple, a library, or a craft guildhall.
translation: 将此区域指定给新建或现有场所。场所由多个区域与房间组成，例如酒馆、神殿、图书馆或工匠公会会馆。

text: Set details for the assigned location.
translation: 设定所属场所的详细资料。

text: Select this option and any unassigned deceased citizens will be buried here automatically.
translation: 启用后，尚未指定墓位的已故居民会自动安葬于此。

text: Select this option and any unassigned deceased pets will be buried here automatically.
translation: 启用后，尚未指定墓位的已故宠物会自动安葬于此。

text: Choose which squads will use this barracks.
translation: 选择使用此兵营的小队。

text: Remove the burrow being painted permanently.  Also removes existing burrows!
translation: 永久移除正在绘制的活动范围，也会移除现有活动范围！

text: Repaint this burrow.
translation: 重新绘制此活动范围。

text: Erase a portion of this burrow.
translation: 擦除此活动范围的一部分。

text: Remove this burrow permanently.
translation: 永久移除此活动范围。

text: Recenter on this burrow.
translation: 将视角置中于此活动范围。

text: Toggle whether workshops can source materials from outside the burrow.
translation: 切换工坊是否可使用活动范围外的材料。

text: Suspend this burrow.  Assigned citizens will not respect burrow restrictions while a burrow is suspended, but all tasks within the burrow will still function.
translation: 暂停此活动范围。暂停期间，所属居民不受范围限制，但范围内的工作仍可正常进行。

text: Add a stop to this route.  Minecarts will move between stops when conditions are satisfied.
translation: 为此路线新增停靠点。条件满足时，矿车会在停靠点之间移动。

text: Assign a minecart to this route.  Only one vehicle can operate on each route.
translation: 为此路线指定矿车。每条路线只能使用一辆矿车。

text: Name this route.
translation: 命名此路线。

text: Remove this route.
translation: 移除此路线。

text: Set the items desired by the minecart at this stop.  Items must be in a linked stockpile.
translation: 设定矿车在此停靠点要装载的物品。物品必须位于已连结的储物堆。

text: Link a stockpile to this stop.  Citizens will haul items to and from the minecart as you specify.  Items for the minecart must be specified using the desired items button to the left.
translation: 将储物堆连结至此停靠点。居民会依设定替矿车装卸物品；请使用左侧的所需物品按钮指定装载内容。

text: Set conditions for the minecart to move on to the next stop.
translation: 设定矿车前往下一个停靠点的条件。

text: Name this stop.
translation: 命名此停靠点。

text: Remove this stop.
translation: 移除此停靠点。

text: The assigned vehicle is at this stop.
translation: 指定的矿车位于此停靠点。

text: The assigned vehicle is moving toward this stop.
translation: 指定的矿车正前往此停靠点。

text: The assigned vehicle wants to be at this stop but is not currently there.  A worker may be bringing it, or it may be stranded.
translation: 指定的矿车应位于此停靠点，但目前不在。工人可能正在搬运，也可能已经受困。

text: Toggle whether the stockpile allows plant and animal-based objects, regardless of other settings.
translation: 切换储物堆是否接受植物与动物来源的物品，不受其他设定影响。

text: Toggle whether goods banned by export mandates are listed.
translation: 切换是否列出被出口禁令禁止交易的货物。

text: Sort by distance from the depot.
translation: 依与贸易站的距离排序。

text: Sort by value.
translation: 依价值排序。

text: (De)select all currently displayed items
translation: 选取或取消选取所有目前显示的物品。

text: Leave menu and open the item's sheet.
translation: 离开选单并开启物品资料。

text: Toggle the forbidden status of the item.  Citizens will not use forbidden items or buildings.
translation: 切换物品的禁用状态。居民不会使用禁用的物品或建筑。

text: Toggle the dump status of the item.  Items are dumped in dumping zones.
translation: 切换物品的弃置状态。物品会被搬至垃圾弃置区。

text: Toggle the melt status of the item.  Items are melted at any smelter.
translation: 切换物品的熔解状态。物品可在任一熔炉熔解。

text: Toggle the visibility of the item.  Hidden items cannot be seen but citizens will still use them.
translation: 切换物品是否可见。隐藏的物品不会显示，但居民仍会使用。

text: Create a new work order.  Work orders are like workshop jobs but they are assigned to shops automatically and can be activated with various conditions.
translation: 建立新工作订单。工作订单会自动分派至工坊，并可设定各种启动条件。

text: This work order is active.
translation: 此工作订单正在执行。

text: This work order is waiting for its next scheduled check.
translation: 此工作订单正等待下一次排定的条件检查。

text: This work order is checking its conditions for activation.
translation: 此工作订单正在检查启动条件。

text: This work order is ready to activate.
translation: 此工作订单已可启动。

text: Set the maximum number of workshops that can be used by the work order.
translation: 设定此工作订单最多可使用的工坊数量。

text: This work order has been validated by the manager.
translation: 此工作订单已由管理员核准。

text: This work order has not been validated by the manager.  A manager can be employed in the nobles and administrators menu, and they must have an assigned office where they will work to validate orders.
translation: 此工作订单尚未经管理员核准。可在贵族与行政人员选单任命管理员，并为其指派办公室以核准订单。

text: Change the number of times the task will be performed.
translation: 更改工作执行次数。

text: Change the work order priority.  Work orders at the top of the list will use workshops first.
translation: 更改工作订单的优先顺序。清单顶端的订单会优先使用工坊。

text: Set the conditions for work order activation.  This can involve needed materials, the current stock of products, or the completion of other work orders.
translation: 设定工作订单的启动条件，可依所需材料、产品库存或其他订单完成情况设定。

text: Set the material used or other details of the task.
translation: 设定工作使用的材料或其他详细资料。

text: Remove this work order.
translation: 移除此工作订单。

text: Change the frequency that the conditions are checked.
translation: 更改条件检查频率。

text: Add a condition to the work order that checks the amount of some item.
translation: 为工作订单新增检查物品数量的条件。

text: Make the activation of the work order depend on the status of another work order.
translation: 依另一张工作订单的状态决定是否启动此订单。

text: Change the amount of the item being checked.
translation: 更改条件所检查的物品数量。

text: Change the inequality of the condition.
translation: 更改条件使用的比较关系。

text: Change the type of the item being checked.
translation: 更改条件所检查的物品类型。

text: Change the material of the item being checked.
translation: 更改条件所检查的物品材料。

text: Change the properties of the item being checked.  Many of these are obscure and rely on specific tasks, but certain properties like 'empty' can be used in many conditions.
translation: 更改条件所检查的物品属性。有些属性只适用于特定工作；「空的」等属性则可用于多种条件。

text: Change whether the work order must be activated or completed to satisfy this condition.
translation: 设定另一张工作订单必须启动或完成，才能满足此条件。

text: Remove this condition.
translation: 移除此条件。

text: Leave this menu and recenter on this creature.
translation: 离开此选单并将视角置中于此生物。

text: Leave this menu and view this creature's sheet.
translation: 离开此选单并查看此生物资料。

text: Leave this menu and recenter on this object.
translation: 离开此选单并将视角置中于此物件。

text: Leave this menu and view this object's sheet.
translation: 离开此选单并查看此物件资料。

text: Leave this menu and recenter on this place.
translation: 离开此选单并将视角置中于此地点。

text: Leave this menu and view this place's sheet or menu.
translation: 离开此选单并查看此地点资料或选单。

text: Leave this menu and recenter on the task's building.
translation: 离开此选单并将视角置中于工作的建筑。

text: Set the details of this task, such as the material used.
translation: 设定此工作的详细资料，例如使用的材料。

text: View a detailed description of this activity.
translation: 查看此活动的详细说明。

text: Toggle whether the task will be repeated indefinitely.
translation: 切换是否无限重复此工作。

text: Remove the current worker from the task.
translation: 将目前工人移出此工作。

text: Suspend this task.  This removes the worker.  The task can be unsuspended.
translation: 暂停此工作并移除工人。之后可恢复执行。

text: Cancel this task.
translation: 取消此工作。

text: Assign a trainer to this creature.
translation: 为此生物指派训练员。

text: Assign this creature as a work animal for a specific citizen or resident.
translation: 将此生物指定为某位公民或居民的工作动物。

text: Toggle whether this creature will receive war training.  War animals have more lethal attacks.
translation: 切换此生物是否接受战斗训练。战斗动物的攻击更致命。

text: Toggle whether this creature will receive hunting training.  Hunting animals can move stealthfully during hunts.
translation: 切换此生物是否接受狩猎训练。狩猎动物可在狩猎时隐蔽移动。

text: Toggle whether this creature is available as a pet for any interested citizen or resident.
translation: 切换此生物是否可供有意愿的公民或居民领养为宠物。

text: This creature is ecstatic right now.
translation: 此生物目前欣喜若狂。

text: This creature is happy right now.
translation: 此生物目前很快乐。

text: This creature is pleased right now.
translation: 此生物目前很愉快。

text: This creature is content right now.
translation: 此生物目前很满足。

text: This creature is displeased right now.
translation: 此生物目前不太高兴。

text: This creature is unhappy right now.
translation: 此生物目前不快乐。

text: This creature is miserable right now.
translation: 此生物目前很痛苦。

text: This worker is specialized and will only do tasks that match their workshop assignments, work details, and occupations.  Click to toggle.
translation: 此工人只执行其所属工坊、工作分组与职务指定的工作。点击切换。

text: This worker is not specialized and will do any free tasks that become available.  Click to toggle.
translation: 此工人会执行任何可承接的工作。点击切换。

text: This creature is a tavern keeper.
translation: 此生物是酒馆管理员。

text: This creature is a performer.
translation: 此生物是表演者。

text: This creature is a scholar.
translation: 此生物是学者。

text: This creature is a scribe.
translation: 此生物是抄写员。

text: This creature is a mercenary.
translation: 此生物是佣兵。

text: This creature is a monster slayer.
translation: 此生物是怪物猎人。

text: This creature is a doctor.
translation: 此生物是医生。

text: This creature is assigned to a specific workshop.
translation: 此生物已指派至指定工坊。

text: This creature is assigned to a work detail.
translation: 此生物已指派至工作分组。

text: Toggle whether this creature will be slaughtered at a butcher's shop when the opportunity arises.
translation: 切换是否在条件允许时，于屠宰场宰杀此生物。

text: Toggle whether this creature will be gelded at a farmer's workshop when the opportunity arises.
translation: 切换是否在条件允许时，于农夫工坊阉割此生物。

text: This type is not relevant to brewing.
translation: 此类物品无法酿酒。

text: This type is restricted from brewing.
translation: 此类物品禁止用于酿酒。

text: This type is allowed to be brewed.
translation: 此类物品允许用于酿酒。

text: This type is not relevant to cooking.
translation: 此类物品无法烹饪。

text: This type is restricted from cooking.
translation: 此类物品禁止用于烹饪。

text: This type is allowed to be cooked.
translation: 此类物品允许用于烹饪。

text: Open the announcements screen.
translation: 开启公告画面。

text: Rename this location.
translation: 重新命名此场所。

text: This option allows visitors from outside the fortress to enter this location.
translation: 此选项允许要塞外的访客进入此场所。

text: This option allows long-term residents of the fortress to enter this location.
translation: 此选项允许要塞的长期居民进入此场所。

text: This option indicates that the location is only open to fortress citizens.
translation: 此选项表示场所仅对要塞公民开放。

text: This option indicates that the location is only open to members.
translation: 此选项表示场所仅对成员开放。

text: Remove this worker from this occupation.
translation: 解除此工人的职务。

text: Set the camera to follow this item.
translation: 设定视角跟随此物品。

text: This item is tagged by a task and will not be used by other tasks.
translation: 此物品已由某项工作预留，其他工作不会使用。

text: See this creature's combat history.
translation: 查看此生物的战斗纪录。

text: This item is part of the assigned squad equipment.
translation: 此物品属于指定的小队装备。

text: This item is a tool assigned by a work detail.
translation: 此物品是工作分组指定的工具。

text: This item is a symbol of a noble or administrator.
translation: 此物品是贵族或行政人员的身分象征。

text: This item is part of the creature's regular clothing.
translation: 此物品属于生物的日常衣物。

text: View this item's sheet.
translation: 查看此物品资料。

text: View this creature's sheet.
translation: 查看此生物资料。

text: View details about this knowledge.
translation: 查看此知识的详细资料。

text: Recenter on this creature.
translation: 将视角置中于此生物。

text: Recenter on this item.
translation: 将视角置中于此物品。

text: Name this building.
translation: 命名此建筑。

text: Remove this building.
translation: 移除此建筑。

text: This task has been assigned and is active.
translation: 此工作已指派并正在执行。

text: This task came from a work order.
translation: 此工作来自工作订单。

text: This task is set to repeat indefinitely.
translation: 此工作已设为无限重复。

text: Click to set this task to repeat indefinitely.
translation: 点击将此工作设为无限重复。

text: This task is highest priority among all tasks everywhere.
translation: 此工作在所有工作中具有最高优先权。

text: Click to set this task as highest priority among all tasks everywhere.
translation: 点击将此工作设为所有工作中的最高优先权。

text: Increase the priority of the task in this workshop.
translation: 提高此工作在工坊内的优先顺序。

text: Set details for this task, such as the material to be used.
translation: 设定此工作的详细资料，例如要使用的材料。

text: This task has been suspended.
translation: 此工作已暂停。

text: Click to suspend the task.  Assigned workers are removed from suspended tasks.
translation: 点击暂停此工作。已指派的工人会被移出暂停的工作。

text: Create a new work order for this workshop.  Work orders are tasks that can repeat specified numbers of times and which can be given start conditions. This is useful for automation.
translation: 为此工坊建立新工作订单。订单可设定重复次数及启动条件，适合自动安排工作。

text: Recenter on the linked building.
translation: 将视角置中于连结的建筑。

text: Add stockpile links for this workshop.
translation: 为此工坊新增储物堆连结。

text: This item is a permanent part of the building.  Forbid and visibility tags set here affect the whole building.
translation: 此物品是建筑的永久构件。此处设定的禁用与可见性会影响整座建筑。

text: This item is being traded.
translation: 此物品正在交易。

text: This is a small creature within the trap.
translation: 这是陷阱内的小型生物。

text: This item is bait.
translation: 此物品是诱饵。

text: This item has been loaded.
translation: 此物品已装载。

text: This item is resting within the building.
translation: 此物品放置于建筑内。

text: This item is a semi-permanent part of the building, like an item on display.
translation: 此物品是建筑的半永久部分，例如展示品。

text: Toggle the forbidden status of the item.  Citizens will not use forbidden items or buildings.  If a permanent building item is forbidden, citizens will not perform tasks there!
translation: 切换物品的禁用状态。居民不会使用禁用的物品或建筑；若禁用永久构件，居民就不会在该建筑工作！

text: Toggle the visibility of the item.  Hidden items cannot be seen but citizens will still use them.  If a permanent building item is invisible, the building will be too!
translation: 切换物品是否可见。居民仍会使用隐藏物品；若隐藏永久构件，整座建筑也会隐藏！

text: Toggle whether the stockpile allows non-plant-and-animal-ba sed objects, regardless of other settings.
translation: 切换储物堆是否接受非动植物来源的物品，不受其他设定影响。

text: Leave menu and recenter the view on the time.
translation: 离开选单并将视角置中于所选物品。

text: The soldiers can either keep their equipment on at all times, or only when an order is active.
translation: 设定士兵随时穿戴装备，或仅在执行命令时穿戴。

text: The soldiers can be allowed to sleep in their rooms whenever they way, or in the barracks either when they want or only when they must.
translation: 设定士兵随时可回房睡觉、自行选择在兵营睡觉，或仅在必要时于兵营睡觉。

text: Cancel this scheduled order.
translation: 取消此排定命令。

text: Cancel this position's scheduled orders.
translation: 取消此职位的排定命令。

text: Change the squad's symbol.
translation: 更改小队徽记。

text: View the leader's sheet.
translation: 查看队长资料。

text: The squad leader is traveling or otherwise occupied off-site.
translation: 队长正在外地旅行或执行其他事务。

text: View the positions in this squad.
translation: 查看此小队的职位。

text: Customize the squad's name.
translation: 自订小队名称。

text: Assign a station order. The soldiers will stand near the point selected and engage any hostile creatures that come near.
translation: 下达驻守命令。士兵会停留在所选位置附近，攻击接近的敌对生物。

text: Assign a kill order.  The soldiers will attempt to kill a targeted creature.
translation: 下达击杀命令。士兵会尝试杀死指定生物。

text: Assign a patrol order.  The soldiers will walk a specified route repeatedly.
translation: 下达巡逻命令。士兵会反复沿指定路线行走。

text: Assign a burrow defense order.  The soldiers will patrol the burrow and attack any hostile creatures.
translation: 下达活动范围防卫命令。士兵会在范围内巡逻并攻击敌对生物。

text: Assign a training order.  The squad must be assigned to a barracks zone with the training option set.
translation: 下达训练命令。小队必须先指派至启用训练选项的兵营区域。

text: Cancel an order.  Does not affect scheduled orders.
translation: 取消命令，不影响排定命令。

text: Disband the squad.
translation: 解散小队。

text: Inspect the route.
translation: 检视路线。

text: Recenter on the announcement's location.
translation: 将视角置中于公告发生地点。

text: Recenter on the creature (at the time of the announcement.)
translation: 将视角置中于生物在公告发生时的位置。

text: Recenter on the item (at the time of the announcement.)
translation: 将视角置中于物品在公告发生时的位置。

text: Toggle whether the squad will sleep here.
translation: 切换小队是否在此睡觉。

text: Toggle whether the squad will train here.
translation: 切换小队是否在此训练。

text: Toggle whether the soldiers will store their individually assigned weapons and armor here.
translation: 切换士兵是否在此存放个人配发的武器与护甲。

text: Toggle whether the squad will store squad-level equipment here, such as ammunition.
translation: 切换小队是否在此存放弹药等共用装备。

text: Choose a stockpile to which the track stop's vehicle will give items.
translation: 选择矿车停靠点要卸货至哪个储物堆。

text: Choose a stockpile from which the track stop's vehicle will take items.
translation: 选择矿车停靠点要从哪个储物堆装货。

text: Choose a stockpile with which the track stop's vehicle will exchange items.  The vehicle will take desired items and offload any others.
translation: 选择矿车停靠点要与哪个储物堆交换物品。矿车会装入所需物品并卸下其他物品。

text: Choose a stockpile to which the workshop will give items.
translation: 选择工坊要将物品送至哪个储物堆。

text: Choose a stockpile from which the workshop will take items.
translation: 选择工坊要从哪个储物堆收取物品。

text: Choose a stockpile to which the selected stockpile will give items.
translation: 选择目前储物堆要将物品送至哪个储物堆。

text: Choose a stockpile from which the selected stockpile will take items.
translation: 选择目前储物堆要从哪个储物堆收取物品。

text: The track stop's vehicle will exchange items with this stockpile.  The vehicle will take desired items and offload any others.
translation: 停靠点的矿车会与此储物堆交换物品，装入所需物品并卸下其他物品。

text: The track stop's vehicle will take items from this stockpile.
translation: 停靠点的矿车会从此储物堆装货。

text: The track stop's vehicle will give items to this stockpile.
translation: 停靠点的矿车会向此储物堆卸货。

text: The selected workshop will take items from here.
translation: 所选工坊会从此处收取物品。

text: The selected workshop will give items to here.
translation: 所选工坊会将物品送至此处。

text: The selected stockpile will take items from here.
translation: 所选储物堆会从此处收取物品。

text: The selected stockpile will give items to here.
translation: 所选储物堆会将物品送至此处。

text: The creature is chained.
translation: 此生物已被拴住。

text: The creature is caged.
translation: 此生物已被关入笼中。

text: The creature is set to be chained.
translation: 此生物已指定要拴住。

text: The creature is set to be caged.
translation: 此生物已指定要关入笼中。

text: The creature is assigned to a pasture.
translation: 此生物已指派至牧场。

text: The creature is assigned to a pond.
translation: 此生物已指派至池塘。

text: The creature is assigned to a pit.
translation: 此生物已指派至坑洞。

text: Edit the recenter hotkey locations.
translation: 编辑视角置中快捷键的地点。

text: Recenter on the surface at this location.
translation: 将视角置中于此地点的地表。

text: Recenter on the deepest discovered area at this location.
translation: 将视角置中于此地点已探索的最深处。

text: Recenter on this location.
translation: 将视角置中于此地点。

text: Set this entry to recenter on the current view.
translation: 将此项目设定为目前视角的置中位置。

text: Clear this recenter hotkey location.
translation: 清除此视角置中快捷键的地点。

text: Delete this recenter location.
translation: 删除此视角置中地点。

text: Display water and magma depth numerically (1 to 7.)
translation: 以数字显示水与岩浆的深度（1 至 7）。

text: Show up and down arrows over ramps at the current elevation.
translation: 在目前高度的斜坡上显示上下箭头。

text: Zoom in on the play area.
translation: 放大游戏区域。

text: Zoom out from the play area.
translation: 拉远游戏区域的视角。

text: View all alerts.
translation: 查看所有警报。

text: Furnaces are used for smelting, glassmaking, pottery, ashmaking, or to make fuel from wood or raw coal.  Furnaces require fuel to function, or they can be set above magma.
translation: 炉窑用于冶炼、制玻璃、烧陶、制灰，或将木材与原煤制成燃料。运作需要燃料，也可设在岩浆上方。

text: These workshops are used in the clothesmaking process, whether dyeing and weaving or using tanned hides.
translation: 这些工坊用于制作衣物，包括染色、织布与加工鞣制皮革。

text: A wide variety of food-and-drink-related workshops can be found in this category.
translation: 此类别包含各种制作食物与饮料的工坊。

text: Used to make lye, potash, and milk of lime.  Construction requires blocks, barrel, and a bucket.
translation: 用于制作碱液、钾碱与石灰乳。建造需要方块、桶与水桶。

text: Make crossbows here from wood or bone.  The metalsmith's forge can be used for metal crossbows and metal bolts, and the crafts workshop is used to make other bolts.
translation: 在此用木材或骨头制作弩。金属弩与弩箭由锻造工坊制作，其他弩箭则由工艺工坊制作。

text: Make beds and various furniture here, as well as bins, barrels, and more.
translation: 在此制作床、各种家具、收纳箱、桶及其他木制品。

text: Make crafts for trade and your own citizens here, as well as a variety of tools, armor, and bolts.
translation: 在此制作供交易或居民使用的工艺品，以及各种工具、护甲与弩箭。

text: Cut rough gems here to increase their value, and improve the value of other objects by encrusting them with cut gems.
translation: 在此切割原石以提高价值，也可将切割宝石镶嵌于其他物品以增加价值。

text: Forge weapons and armor here, as well as most other metal objects from furniture to trap components.  Magma below the forge will power tasks.  You are responsible for placing the forge above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
translation: 在此锻造武器、护甲、金属家具与陷阱零件等。下方岩浆可供热；必须自行将工坊设在岩浆上方，无须其他燃料。

text: Make mechanisms here which are used to make levers, pressure plates, and gears.  You can also use mechanisms to link levers and pressure plates to other machinery.
translation: 在此制作用于杠杆、压力板与齿轮的机械零件，也可用零件将杠杆或压力板连结至其他机械。

text: Forge weapons and armor here, as well as most other metal objects from furniture to trap components.  These tasks require fuel.
translation: 在此锻造武器、护甲、金属家具与陷阱零件等。这些工作需要燃料。

text: Here you can make parts for ballistae and catapults.  This workshop is also the place where ballista ammo is assembled.
translation: 在此制作弩砲与投石机零件，也可组装弩砲弹药。

text: Make stone furniture here, as well as blocks which are used in constructions.
translation: 在此制作石制家具与建筑用石块。

text: Use leather tanned at the tanner's shop here to make clothing and tools, such as bags and waterskins.
translation: 在此将制革坊鞣制的皮革做成衣物、袋子、水囊等。

text: Here you can turn thread into cloth, whether it is thread from the farmer's workshop or spider silk gathered underground.
translation: 在此将农夫工坊制作的线或地下采集的蛛丝织成布。

text: Make cloth into clothing and tools here, such as bags and ropes.
translation: 在此将布制成衣物、袋子、绳索等。

text: Use dyes here to color thread and cloth.  Requires a barrel and bucket for construction.
translation: 在此用染料为线与布染色。建造需要桶与水桶。

text: Slaughter livestock here in order to obtain meat, hides, bones, and other animal products.
translation: 在此宰杀牲畜，取得肉、兽皮、骨头等动物产品。

text: Make leather from animal hides here.  You can also make parchment using milk of lime and a hide.
translation: 在此将兽皮制成皮革，也可用石灰乳与兽皮制作羊皮纸。

text: Process raw fish into edible food here.  Raw fish will not be eaten.
translation: 在此将未处理的鱼加工成食物。居民不会直接食用未处理的鱼。

text: Cook meals here.  You can also render fat into tallow.
translation: 在此烹调餐点，也可将脂肪熬成油脂。

text: Process plants and work with livestock here.  Milk and shear animals, make cheese, and spin thread.
translation: 在此处理植物与牲畜，进行挤奶、剪毛、制作乳酪与纺线。

text: Make sugar, flour, and various useful slurries here.  Tasks are completed very slowly compared to the powered millstone.
translation: 在此制作糖、面粉与各种浆料。相较于动力磨石，处理速度很慢。

text: Capture and train small animals here.  Requires animal traps.
translation: 在此捕捉与训练小动物，需要动物陷阱。

text: Make sugar, flour, and various useful slurries here.  Powered version of the quern.  Must be hooked to a windmill or water wheel to function.
translation: 在此制作糖、面粉与各种浆料。这是动力式手磨，必须连接风车或水车才能运作。

text: You can make a variety of objects using three different types of glass.  You can also collect sand in bags from a task originating here, if you have a sand collection zone.  Glassmaking requires fuel.
translation: 可用三种玻璃制作各式物品。若有采砂区，也可在此下达用袋子采砂的工作。制玻璃需要燃料。

text: Bake clay objects here, as well as a few other useful materials.  Clay can also be collected here if you have a clay collection zone.  All tasks require fuel aside from clay collection.
translation: 在此烧制陶器与其他材料。若有采黏土区，也可在此下达采集工作。除采黏土外，所有工作都需要燃料。

text: You can make a variety of objects using three different types of glass.  You can also collect sand in bags from a task originating here, if you have a sand collection zone.  Magma below the furnace will power tasks.  You are responsible for placing the furnace above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
translation: 可用三种玻璃制作物品；有采砂区时也可下达用袋子采砂的工作。下方岩浆可供热；必须将炉窑设在岩浆上方，无须其他燃料。

text: Bake clay objects here, as well as a few other useful materials.  Clay can also be collected here if you have a clay collection zone.  Magma below the kiln will power tasks.  You are responsible for placing the kiln above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
translation: 在此烧制陶器与其他材料。有采黏土区时也可下达采集工作。下方岩浆可供热；必须将窑设在岩浆上方，无须其他燃料。

text: Make metal bars from ore here.  Can also refine coal into usable fuel or make alloys.  Magma below the smelter will power tasks.  You are responsible for placing the smelter above the magma, but no other fuel is required.
translation: 在此将矿石炼成金属锭、将原煤制成燃料或制作合金。下方岩浆可供热；必须将熔炉设在岩浆上方，无须其他燃料。

text: Make metal bars from ore here.  Can also refine coal into usable fuel or make alloys.  All tasks require fuel.
translation: 在此将矿石炼成金属锭、将原煤制成燃料或制作合金。所有工作都需要燃料。

text: Make charcoal and ash from wood here.  Does not require fuel.
translation: 在此将木材制成木炭与灰，无须燃料。

text: Plant crops at the farmplot.  You will need seeds or spawn and must select crops by season.  Crops can be fertilized with potash. Soil is richer deeper underground.
translation: 在农田种植作物，需要种子或菌种，并按季节选择作物。可用钾碱施肥；地下深处的土壤更肥沃。

text: When placed, a female bird will claim the box and start laying eggs, if one is available.
translation: 放置后，若有合适的雌鸟，牠会占用巢箱并开始产卵。

text: Keep a colony of insects at your hives.  A wild colony must be collected after the hive is placed, or a colony can be split from an existing hive colony.
translation: 在蜂箱饲养虫群。放置后可采集野生虫群，或从现有蜂箱分出新虫群。

text: Your citizens need a comfortable place to sleep.  A bed object must be made at the carpenter's shop before it can be placed.
translation: 居民需要舒适的睡眠场所。放置床之前，须先在木工工坊制作。

text: Chairs are required for offices to function, and a chair next to a table is the preferred dining arrangement.  A chair/throne object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 办公室需要椅子才能运作。用餐时宜将椅子放在桌旁。放置之前，须先制作椅子或宝座。

text: Tables are required for dining.  A chair should be placed adjacent to the table.  A table object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 用餐需要桌子，桌旁应放置椅子。放置之前，须先制作桌子。

text: Chests and coffers are used in personal bedrooms for storing non-clothing objects.  They are also used in some zone-based locations like taverns, hospitals, and libraries for storing useful materials.  A box object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 箱柜用于卧室存放衣物以外的物品，也用于酒馆、医院与图书馆等场所存放用品。放置之前，须先制作箱柜。

text: Cabinets are used in personal bedrooms for storing clothing objects.  A cabinet object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 衣柜用于卧室存放衣物。放置之前，须先制作衣柜。

text: The dead are buried in coffins.  Coffins must be placed in their own tomb zone in order to work.  A coffin object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 死者安葬于棺材。棺材必须放在独立墓葬区域内才能使用。放置之前，须先制作棺材。

text: Citizens that cannot be buried properly can still be memorialized on slabs.  Slabs are created and engraved at the stoneworker's shop.
translation: 无法妥善安葬的居民仍可用石碑纪念。石碑在石工工坊制作与雕刻。

text: Statues can be used to decorate your fortress and add value to your rooms.  A statue object must be made at an appropriate workshop first.
translation: 雕像可装饰要塞并提高房间价值。放置之前，须先在合适的工坊制作。

text: Certain injuries such as overlapping fractures require advanced medical contraptions like the traction bench for treatment.  A traction bench object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 错位骨折等伤势需要牵引床等进阶医疗设备治疗。放置之前，须先制作牵引床。

text: Codices and scrolls in your library can be stored in bookcases.  A bookcase object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 图书馆的书籍与卷轴可存放于书柜。放置之前，须先制作书柜。

text: Your most valuable objects can be placed for display in rooms to increase their value and to entertain passing citizens.  A pedestal or display case must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 可在房间展示珍贵物品，提高房间价值并供路过居民观赏。放置之前，须先制作展示台或展示柜。

text: These ornamental objects increase the value of rooms in which they are placed.  An offering place object must be made before it can be placed.
translation: 这些装饰物可提高所在房间的价值。放置之前，须先制作供奉台。

text: Large instruments must be placed in taverns or temples before they will be used.  These instruments must be assembled at a workshop first.
translation: 大型乐器放置于酒馆或神殿后才会使用。放置之前，须先在工坊组装。

text: Doors can be used along with walls to enclose rooms, which is especially important when placing multiple zones at once.  Doors can also be forbidden or attached to levers to control movement in the fort.
translation: 门与墙可围成房间，对同时划设多个区域尤其重要。也可禁用门或连接杠杆，控制要塞内的通行。

text: Hatches can be placed at the tops of stairwells or above ramps to control movement in the fort when they are forbidden or attached to levers.
translation: 活板门可放在楼梯井顶端或斜坡上方，借由禁用或连接杠杆来控制通行。

text: Bridges can be used to span open spaces or placed above water or magma.  Bridges can be connected to levers and raised to block access.
translation: 桥可跨越空地，或设在水与岩浆上方。连接杠杆后可升起，以阻挡通行。

text: Paved roads use less materials than constructed floors and can be used to stop plants from growing over wagon trails.
translation: 铺设道路比建造地板省材料，并可防止植物占据货车路线。

text: Dirt roads do not require materials, but the dirt road may quickly be overgrown by plants.
translation: 土路不需要材料，但可能很快被植物覆盖。

text: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items.  Can be built on any floor.  Grates unlike bars have a quality and enhance the value of rooms.  Grates can be connected to levers.
translation: 阻挡生物，但液体与物品可通过。可建于地板上。格栅具有品质，能提高房间价值，也可连接杠杆。

text: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items.  Can be built over empty spaces, stairs, ramps, or above liquids.  Grates unlike bars have a quality and enhance the value of rooms.  Grates can be connected to levers.
translation: 阻挡生物，但液体与物品可通过。可建于空地、楼梯、斜坡或液体上方。格栅具有品质，能提高房间价值，也可连接杠杆。

text: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items.  Can be built on any floor.  Bars unlike grates do not have a quality and so do not enhance the value of rooms significantly.  Bars can be connected to levers.
translation: 阻挡生物，但液体与物品可通过。可建于地板上。栅栏没有品质，对房间价值提升有限，也可连接杠杆。

text: Blocks creatures but allows the passage of fluids and items.  Can be built over empty spaces, stairs, ramps, or above liquids.  Bars unlike grates do not have a quality and so do not enhance the value of rooms significantly.  Bars can be connected to levers.
translation: 阻挡生物，但液体与物品可通过。可建于空地、楼梯、斜坡或液体上方。栅栏没有品质，对房间价值提升有限，也可连接杠杆。

text: This ornamental construction can enhance the value of rooms.  A window object must be made at a glass furnace before it can be placed.
translation: 此装饰建筑可提高房间价值。放置之前，须先在玻璃炉制作窗户。

text: This ornamental construction can enhance the value of rooms.  Three cut gem objects must be made at a jeweler's shop before it can be placed.
translation: 此装饰建筑可提高房间价值。放置之前，须先在珠宝工坊切割三颗宝石。

text: Supports will stop cave-ins in the rare event you completely detach a piece of your fortress.  Otherwise, they are ornamental.
translation: 当要塞某部分完全失去其他支撑时，支柱可防止坍塌。其他情况下主要作为装饰。

text: You can build walls aboveground, in caverns, or in spaces you have mined out in order to block the passage of creatures, objects, and fluids.  Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 可在地表、洞穴或挖掘出的空间建墙，阻挡生物、物品与液体。需要巨石、方块或木材。

text: You can build reinforced walls aboveground, in caverns, or in spaces you have mined out in order to block the passage of creatures, objects, and fluids.  Requires two boulder, block, or wood, and metal bars.  Provides some resistance to invaders.
translation: 可在地表、洞穴或挖掘出的空间建强化墙，阻挡生物、物品与液体。需要两份巨石、方块或木材，以及金属锭，能抵抗部分入侵攻击。

text: You can place floors for functional reasons or to enhance the appearance of the fortress.  Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 可铺设地板以供使用或美化要塞。需要巨石、方块或木材。

text: You can build a ramp next to a wall to provide access to the floor above.  The space above the ramp must also be empty.  Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 可在墙旁建斜坡以通往上一层，斜坡正上方也必须留空。需要巨石、方块或木材。

text: You can build staircases to connect different elevations.  Staircases must span at least two elevations.  Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 可建楼梯连接不同高度，楼梯至少须跨越两层。需要巨石、方块或木材。

text: Fortifications block creature movement but allow projectiles through.  Soldiers near fortifications are reasonably safe from incoming projectiles.  Requires boulder, block, or wood.
translation: 射击垛墙阻挡生物，但投射物可穿过。附近士兵能获得一定掩护。需要巨石、方块或木材。

text: Use minecart tracks in conjunction with the hauling menu.
translation: 矿车轨道须搭配运输选单使用。

text: Place the well in an open space above water to provide a relatively safe area for your citizens to draw water. Requires mechanisms, blocks, a chain or rope, and a bucket.
translation: 将水井放在水面上方的空格，提供较安全的取水处。需要机械零件、方块、链条或绳索，以及水桶。

text: Use floodgates to control the flow of fluids between spaces in your fortress.  Must be attached to a lever or pressure plate to function.  Requires a floodgate object to be built before it can be placed.
translation: 水闸用于控制要塞内的液体流动，必须连接杠杆或压力板才能操作。放置之前，须先制作水闸。

text: Use a screw pump to move liquids upward from the elevation below the pump to the same elevation as the pump.
translation: 螺旋泵可将下一层的液体抽升至泵所在的高度。

text: Place the water wheel above flowing water to generate power for machines, such as the millstone or screw pump.
translation: 将水车设在流水上方，为磨石或螺旋泵等机械提供动力。

text: Place the windmill aboveground to generate power for machines, such as the millstone or screw pump.  Not all areas have strong winds.
translation: 将风车设在地表，为磨石或螺旋泵等机械提供动力。并非所有地区都有强风。

text: Use the gear assembly to connect axles and machinery together.  Gear assemblies can be disengaged temporarily by linking them to levers.
translation: 齿轮组用于连接传动轴与机械。连接杠杆后，可暂时切断传动。

text: Horizontal axles transfer power on the same elevation.  Horizontal axles can be east-west or north-south.
translation: 水平传动轴在同一高度传递动力，可沿东西或南北方向设置。

text: Vertical axles transfer power between two adjacent elevations.
translation: 垂直传动轴在相邻两层之间传递动力。

text: Rollers move minecarts on tracks without the need for a citizen to push or guide the minecart.
translation: 滚轮可推动轨道上的矿车，无须居民推车或引导。

text: A chain can be placed for use in the justice system or for the restraint of an animal.
translation: 链条可供司法拘禁使用，也可用来拴住动物。

text: Cages can be used to contain an animal, and metal cages can be used by the justice system.  Glass cages can be filled with water and used as aquariums.
translation: 笼子可关住动物；金属笼也可供司法拘禁使用。玻璃笼可装水当作水族箱。

text: Animal traps can be placed in the wild and baited with meat, plants, or gems, in order to catch small creatures.
translation: 动物陷阱可设在野外，以肉、植物或宝石作为诱饵，捕捉小型生物。

text: Track stops are used in conjunction with the hauling menu.  They can also be used to add friction to minecart tracks.
translation: 轨道停靠点须搭配运输选单使用，也可增加矿车轨道的摩擦阻力。

text: Levers are used with machines, doors, floodgates, bridges, cages, and other structures to change their state.
translation: 杠杆可控制机械、门、水闸、桥、笼子与其他设施的状态。

text: Pressure plates, like levers, are used with machines, doors, floodgates, bridges, cages, and other structures to change their state.  The trigger for pressure plates can be set by creature weight, fluid, or minecart passage.
translation: 压力板可像杠杆一样控制机械、门、水闸、桥、笼子等设施，可设定由生物重量、液体或通过的矿车触发。

text: Stone-fall traps drop a stone on intruders.  Must be loaded with boulders.
translation: 落石陷阱会向入侵者投下石头，必须装填巨石。

text: Weapon traps use a weapon or trap component to strike intruders.  Can be used with ranged weapons and loaded with ammo.  Can use multiple weapons at once.
translation: 武器陷阱用武器或陷阱零件攻击入侵者，也可装入远程武器与弹药，并同时使用多件武器。

text: Cage traps capture intruders in cages.  Must be loaded with a cage.
translation: 笼陷阱可将入侵者捕入笼中，必须装填笼子。

text: Upright weapons are a nasty place for intruders to fall upon. Can also be linked to levers or pressure plates to raise them into intruders.
translation: 竖立武器可伤害落到上面的入侵者，也可连接杠杆或压力板，升起武器刺击入侵者。

text: Archery targets are used in archery range zones for training archers.
translation: 箭靶用于射箭场区域，供射手训练。

text: Ornamental.  Demanded by some nobles.
translation: 用于装饰，部分贵族会要求设置。

text: A ballista fires a ballista arrow in a fixed direction.  The operator can adjust the aim freely within a cone.
translation: 弩砲朝固定方向发射弩砲箭，操作员可在扇形范围内调整瞄准方向。

text: A catapult fires a boulder in a fixed direction.  The operator can adjust the aim freely within a cone.
translation: 投石机朝固定方向发射巨石，操作员可在扇形范围内调整瞄准方向。

text: A bolt thrower fires a regular bolts rapidly.  The operator swivels the machine from any available adjacent tiles.
translation: 速射弩砲可快速发射一般弩箭。操作员可从相邻的可用地格转动机器。

translation: 白粟植株
